d: Benjamin Netanyahu remains Israel’s caretaker prime minister, but his political position is becoming more precarious. A report says a recent phone call with Donald Trump turned into an “unusually difficult” argument over Iran, with Netanyahu favouring renewed military operations while Trump has hit pause. Netanyahu’s office has rejected the report as “fake news” and “complete nonsense”. At home, Netanyahu has also lost his parliamentary majority. His rival Gadi Eisenkot has been given the first opportunity to form a government, while Netanyahu’s opponents are already proposing bills…
